courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」與「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；單元式帷幕牆安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" and "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「風壓驅動水頭」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到單元式帷幕牆安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wind-driven water head” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Performance mock-up and racking test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
history.text: 外牆水密的現代理解來自「雨幕原理」：讓外層通氣、使腔體壓力接近外部，壓差由內側乾燥的空氣屏障承擔。北美在 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列中建立了實驗室與現場試驗方法，歐洲則以 EN 12153、EN 12155 等標準與 EN 13830 分級。1980 至 2000 年代初英屬哥倫比亞沿海大量公寓漏水，1998 年 Barrett 委員會指出過度依賴表面密封的牆體，促成當地規範要求雨幕構造；2004 年啟用的麻省理工學院 Stata 中心在 2007 年因漏水等問題提起訴訟，2010 年和解；同年代完工的台北 101 則公開其外牆可承受約 95 mm 側向位移。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The modern understanding of façade watertightness comes from the rainscreen principle: vent the outer layer so cavity pressure approaches exterior pressure, leaving the pressure difference to a dry inner air barrier. North America established laboratory and field test methods in ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, while Europe uses standards such as EN 12153 and EN 12155 with classification under EN 13830. From the 1980s to the early 2000s large numbers of condominiums in coastal British Columbia leaked; in 1998 the Barrett Commission identified reliance on face-sealed walls, leading local codes to require rainscreen construction. MIT's Stata Center, opened in 2004, became the subject of a 2007 lawsuit over leaks and other problems, settled in 2010, while Taipei 101, completed in the same era, states publicly that its façade can take about 95 mm of lateral displacement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
